chunks: And it is narrated from Abū al-Rabīʿ al-Shāmī, from Abū ʿAbdillāh عليه السلام, who said:
No one should purchase anything from the lands of the people of al-Sawād except one who has a covenant, for indeed it is fayʾ for the Muslims.

key_terms.أَرَاضِي: lands or territories under discussion in the ruling
key_terms.أَهْلِ السَّوَادِ: the people of al-Sawād, referring to the region whose lands are mentioned
key_terms.ذِمَّةٌ: a covenant, protected status, or recognized legal entitlement
key_terms.فَيْءٌ: property classified as fayʾ, communal revenue belonging to the Muslims

ai.seo_question: Who is permitted to purchase land from the lands of al-Sawād according to Imam al-Sadiq عليه السلام?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a legal ruling regarding the purchase of lands in al-Sawād, restricting such transactions to one who possesses a recognized covenant or entitlement. It explains that these lands are regarded as fayʾ belonging to the Muslims, indicating their collective public status rather than unrestricted private property.

en.bab-ul-qaim-publications: Hadith.3879 - It is narrated from Abu Al-Rabi' Al-Shami, from Abu Abdillah (as), who said:
"Do not purchase anything from the lands of the Sawad except from those who have a covenant, for it is a spoils (fay') for the Muslims."
